definitions.explanation: A period at the beginning of employment during which a new employee's performance and suitability are evaluated. Also used for trial periods of products or services.

examples.japanese: {試用期間|しようきかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}です。
examples.english: The probation period is three months.

examples.japanese: {試用期間|しようきかん}{中|ちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An evaluation is conducted during the probation period.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{試用期間|しようきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This software becomes paid after the trial period expires.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese employment, the {試用期間|しようきかん} typically lasts 3-6 months. During this period, the employer may terminate employment more easily than after formal hiring, though labor protections still apply after 14 days.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試用期間|しようきかん}{中|ちゅう} (during the probation period)
- {試用期間|しようきかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧ (to establish a probation period)
- {試用期間|しようきかん}{満了|まんりょう} (completion of probation period)

FORMS:
⟦{試用|しよう}→試用：23966_shiyou⟧ (trial use) + ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (period).
